title: Private Country Without a Map
style: dark alternative R&B, female lead vocal, northeastern American English diction, slow nocturnal groove, sub-heavy rounded bass, sparse swung drums, minor-key electric piano, glassy synth pads, intimate close-mic verses, restrained melodic chorus, tense spacious production, subtle vocal doubles, polished but emotionally uneasy mix
lyrics:
[Intro]
You came asking for a refill
I gave you a room instead

[Verse 1]
Passport folded in your coat
Spanish first, but your English held
You wanted ten more quiet months
I asked what your attention felt

You build a map for every room
Count the exits, read the face
High mind, careful hands
A system where instinct leaves no trace

[Pre-Chorus]
When the noise fell out of you
The older pattern came in view
A different shape beneath the calm
A private country without a map

[Chorus]
Tell me where you hide the tender part
Behind the partners, behind the clever heart
You can name desire, you can name the rules
But who gets close when you have nothing left to prove?
I watched you look, then look away
Watched the mask arrive a second late
You said you’re fine, your body disagreed
And something in you answered me

[Verse 2]
Since thirteen, the little white line
Kept the engines in their place
Then the room grew sharper
And the difference showed its face

Three names living in your chest
One shares a child and history
One waits across New York
One works beside you, unnamed electricity

You give them all a measured truth
A polished edge, a careful dose
But every time the flirting starts
The guarded door comes loose

[Pre-Chorus]
You fear the harm your honesty could make
You fear a vow would turn to ache
You call it freedom, call it need
I hear the loneliness underneath

[Chorus]
Tell me where you hide the tender part
Behind the partners, behind the clever heart
You can name desire, you can name the rules
But who gets close when you have nothing left to prove?
I watched you look, then look away
Watched the mask arrive a second late
You said you’re fine, your body disagreed
And something in you answered me

[Bridge]
Claire is the name you cannot bruise
The promise you refuse to choose
You say that monogamy would rot
You say resentment would be all you’ve got

I asked for consent, you gave it clear
No shame, no flinch, no borrowed fear
Now every session leaves a door
And you are saying more than before

[Final Chorus]
Tell me where you hide the tender part
Not in a chart, not in a guarded heart
You can keep your lovers, keep your rules
Just let one truth arrive before you lose
I watched you look, then look away
This time the mask did not obey
You said you’re fine, but stayed with me
And something in you learned to breathe

[Outro]
Schedule it around New York
Bring the silence you protect
No refill without the whole of you
No more leaving tenderness unchecked
